from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated extraction from a single document processing step."""
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
